## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Energy, Industrials, Communication positive) but major tech large-caps show bifurcation (MSFT, ORCL, INTU, NOW weak) → mixed signals; Leadership concentration is narrow (3/5 Communication).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication lead: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND; Energy showing strength: CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall (1W: -0.98% | 19 stocks) with MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare weak with UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND and CVS (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -5.91%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary showing pockets of strain: TSLA (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -2.39% | 1M: +8.15%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.10% | 1M: -24.13%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -5.91%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in big-cap Tech and select Healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: VZ (1W: +12.65%), TXN (1W: +12.23%), T (1W: +11.11%), META (1W: +8.76%), LMT (1W: +7.35%). Watch TMUS (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY for potential short-term trend change; note major divergence among large caps (AAPL, JPM, MA showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to cautious: NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND are bright spots, while MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -11.53% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND drag the group; sector 1W performance: -0.98% (19 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Internals mixed but constructive: JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -6.55%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W +1.39% (20 stocks) suggests selective strength in payment/large bank pockets amid divergent 1M performance.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Rotation into select defensives is uneven: JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND contrast with UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W -2.16% (15 stocks) — watch headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure: CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +16.87%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND and selective Financials (JPM RECOVERY) versus reduce exposure to stretched Tech names showing acute 1W weakness (MSFT, ORCL, INTU BELOW TREND). Given NEUTRAL regime and major large-cap divergence, maintain selectivity and monitor catalysts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND — headline-confirmed; CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/cash-return story; VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND — buyback/fiber catalyst. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND — earnings shock; CHTR (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY with bearish headline — divergence; TMUS (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY with negative sentiment — at risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.51% | major names ABOVE TREND) and Industrials (1W: +1.10% | strong AI/defense flows). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.98% | large-cap dispersion) and Healthcare (1W: -2.16% | headline-driven sell-offs).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through above recent swing highs for momentum confirmation. AAPL (1W: +4.61% | 1M: -4.98%) RECOVERY — watch whether 1W strength sustains above the 1M pivot. MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND — renewed weakness below short-term support would signal deeper tech retrenchment. JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY — monitor for confirmation above recent resistance to validate financials’ tilt.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): Myeloma approval — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) — sentiment confirmed. CVX (+55): earnings/cash-return narrative — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) — confirmed. VZ (+55): buyback/fiber deal — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) — confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-60): earnings shock/Medicare strain — price BELOW TREND (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) — sentiment confirmed. CHTR (-55): earnings miss headline vs price RECOVERY (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) — divergence, distribution risk. TMUS (-50): competitive pressure guidance — price RECOVERY (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) — headline at risk of reversing short-term bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND and TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence (AAPL, JPM, MA, CHTR) and headline-driven Healthcare names (UNH) — watch sentiment-confirmation.
